Messages.Author: simcof
Messages.Body:
Hi guys,

Having a bit of an argument on jol at the moment on what an action
card is for the purpose of Louhi's ability.

Do allies, retainers, equipment and political actions count as "action
cards"?

Cheers,
simcof

Messages.Author: Jozxyqk
Messages.Body:
simcof <sim...@gmail.com> wrote:
> Do allies, retainers, equipment and political actions count as "action
> cards"?

Yes.
So do Imbued Powers.
Basic rule of thumb: any card that can be played as an action is an action card.
In the newest printings, they all have the "Action" symbol on them in addition
to their subtype symbol, which is also a good clue.
